scope: Conservative local/test decision guidance and a guard in the existing browser recorder path, using supplied observations and existing environment/take structures. No classifier or general permission framework.
behavior: Require target, task authorization, no-login/test/demo account, invented-data provenance, task-only profile and checked production indicators before recorder startup, including rehearsals.
Missing or blocked observations leave an existing failed-take shape with environment_check stage, null timing, empty events/recorder facts and a clarification error; the error still propagates.
New successful/start-failed takes add supplied observations and decision to capture_request; prior timing/events/cleanup and original records are preserved.
Trusted preflight identifies its own synthetic facts and requires caller-supplied task-profile mode before browser access. It cannot supply an implicit decision for the app.
Edit-only work retains source provenance and privacy limitations without inventing a capture check.

local_proof.before: Published helper reaches stubbed recorder startup for all six supplied cases, including four disallowed contexts; ordinary published API used, not an unfamiliar-flag rejection.
local_proof.after: Two allowed contexts reach stubbed recording; four blocked contexts produce clarification and no browser/recorder calls or reel.
local_proof.environment: Builder Python 3.14.2, FFmpeg/ffprobe 8.0 and Pillow 12.1.1. Supplied-observation and deterministic stub proof, not live banner recognition.
local_proof.review_attribution: Builder local results remain separate from the relayed independent review below.

limitations: Helper evaluates supplied facts; no automatic banner, account, profile or private-data inspection. Caller must establish truth and recheck changed conditions.
Direct native recorder commands and other capture tools remain subject to guidance, outside this helper guard.
No live browser or fresh child compliance run, no new reel, no privacy clearance.
The original two S3 agent-run criterion, scenario/harness, alignment/calibration and other prerequisites remain unverified.
next_action: Only assigned T3.2 sampled privacy review/handoff, left uncommitted for independent review. Original two-S3-run criterion stays open.
